entities.summary: Hindu Swayamsevak Sangh is a non-profit, social, educational, and cultural organisation of Hindus living outside India. It is a subsidiary of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS), a right-wing Hindutva paramilitary organisation. It was founded in 1940s in Kenya, it is currently active in 156 countries and estimates 3289 branches.
